June is just around the corner, and with the new month comes the next Apple Watch fitness challenge.

Global Running Day set for Wednesday, June 3

Apple Watch users will be able to complete the Global Running Day Challenge next week on Wednesday, June 3.

Completing the virtual activity challenge requires logging a running workout with at least 5K (3.1 miles) distance.

Global running Day Challenge participants will unlock a digital trophy as well as Fitness app stickers to mark the virtual event.

Four animated stickers include someone running in a dinosaur costume, a pair of people running together, someone running with their dog, and a colorful version of the 2026 Global Running Day Challenge award.

Apple Watch Series 11 is currently priced from $299 on Amazon.
